## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Master Lù's Summary of Regulations for the Daoist Gate*

by [陸修靜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B8%E4%BF%AE%E9%9D%9C) (Lù Xiūjìng, 406–477) — founding Líng bǎo patriarch

**A foundational document of organized Daoism** — Lù Xiūjìng's concise summary of **regulations and rites** for the Tiān shī / Celestial Masters tradition as it functioned in the mid-fifth century. Lù was the single most important figure in the Nán-Cháo reorganization of the Daoist canon and ritual system; this manual is a primary source for his reform program. Preserved as **DZ 1127** / CT 1127 (Tài píng bù 太平部).

**Dating.** Within Lù Xiūjìng's lifetime (406–477). Dynasty: 南朝.
